_doc: Spec<->production correspondence ledger for the endpoint (docs/ENDPOINT.md). status: proved | certified | measured | gap | unexamined. E1 exits SUCCESS only when no item is unexamined.

items.what: fresh pristine run reproduces the archived diagonal table
items.evidence: tests/test_endpoint_e0.py::test_fresh_run_reproduces_archive

items.what: diagonal table is invariant under a change of basis inside degenerate multiplets
items.evidence: tests/test_endpoint_e0.py::test_basis_change_invariance (BLAS threads change the basis: raw offdiag moves, diagonal table does not)

items.what: number_bands does not cut a degenerate multiplet at any k+q entering the sums
items.evidence: Sigma: test_band_window_does_not_cut_multiplets; Epsilon: bands 18/19 of WFN split by >= 0.023 Ry at both shifted k-points

items.what: Coulomb kernel prefactor, cell volume, k/q weights
